artworks.title: The Miser
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove tissue
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a simple interior scene. The artwork depicts a rustic room with wooden walls and ceiling beams. On the left, a large wooden bench spans the length of one wall, supporting a vase or pitcher. The bench's legs are angled. On the opposite side, a square-paned window lets light into the room, casting shadows on the floor. The light contrasts with the darker tones used on a curtain or heavy fabric hanging beside the window. The composition is sparse yet detailed, with fine lines used to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Little Rotherhithe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid tissue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy harbor scene with various vessels on the water. The view is from an elevated position, capturing sailboats with high masts. The scene is depicted using delicate linear strokes, creating textures for the boats and water. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. Some boats are close by with figures onboard, while more ships are seen further out. In the distance, buildings and a narrowing waterway create a bustling backdrop against the sky.

artworks.title: The Little Rotherhithe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene, showing boats in the water with buildings in the distance. The horizon divides the water and the sky, with boat masts visible just above it. The style is etching with loose, sketch-like brushstrokes. The color scheme is primarily sepia or dark brown. The scene conveys a sense of activity with boats carrying goods and figures in small boats. The background shows softer, less defined forms, adding depth to the harbor setting.

artworks.title: The Little Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on grey laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with ships, buildings, and figures. The perspective appears elevated, possibly from a dock. The horizon is at the top, showing a cityscape with moored ships. The drawing uses fine lines, capturing movement and details. Two figures are at the edge, one seated and one standing. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia or brown against a light background. The composition leads the eye from close details to the distant ships and buildings, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: The Little Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a river scene from an elevated viewpoint. Two figures in hats are on a dock or platform overlooking the river. Boats are lined up along the water's edge, with more vessels in the distance. The horizon shows faint distant buildings and tall ship masts against the sky. The cityscape is visible above the center. The artwork is created with delicate, linear brushstrokes in monochromatic shades, giving it an impressionistic style.

artworks.title: Old Hungerford Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a top-down view of a busy river with boats and a suspension bridge. Buildings and a bridge are visible on the far horizon. The water displays movement, with boats and people. The color scheme is primarily brown and black, creating a monochromatic look. The bridge's intricate framework stands out against the background. Faint outlines of a cloudy sky and cityscape are visible beyond the bridge. Closest to the viewer are boats and poles in the water.

artworks.title: Jo's Bent Head
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person with the upper part of their torso shown. The person is sitting with their head slightly bowed forward and facing the front. They have shoulder-length wavy hair. The facial features are softly drawn, with a visible outline of the profile. The person's clothing is loosely sketched, and no additional details are provided. There are no visible accessories or objects in the person's hands. The background is textured and shaded, emphasizing the person's form without any specific details.

artworks.title: The Punt
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a riverside view, from the perspective of being on a boat. A man stands at the edge of the boat holding a long pole. The horizon is low with a line of trees. Some tall trees, possibly poplars, stand out. The etching uses a variety of line styles, including fine lines for the sky and bolder strokes for the man. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black ink on light beige or cream paper. The scene extends into the distance with more trees visible, casting reflections on the calm river surface blending into the sky.

artworks.title: Sketching, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a scene by a riverbank with a small boat carrying two figures. The horizon is shown in the upper third of the image, meeting rolling hills and the sky. Trees line the riverbank in the distance, reflecting in the water. The etching style uses intricate lines to depict texture and detail in the natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia shades. Near us, a figure is sitting, either sketching or observing the scene.

artworks.title: Ross Winans
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on chine collé
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man seated, shown from the waist up. He is slightly turned to the side, with his gaze towards the viewer. He has a mustache and curly, short hair. He wears a suit with a jacket, vest, and loosely knotted tie. He is holding a stack of books, including a smaller object with a silhouette of a person's head. Beside him is a violin and bow. The background is sparsely detailed with cross-hatching and shading.

artworks.title: Chelsea Wharf
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dockside area with sailing vessels moored closely to the viewer. The horizon is near the top of the image, with outlines of buildings and masts. The fine lines of the etching depict structures and rigging. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or black ink. In the distance, there are outlines of buildings and ships, while figures attend to the boats in the foreground. Chelsea Wharf is clearly marked on a building.

artworks.title: Amsterdam from the Tolhuis
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with buildings and ships outlined against the horizon line. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching for shading in the sky and water, creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark ink lines on a light background. Boats with figures are anchored near the shore, while more ships are seen in the distance, suggesting a busy port.

artworks.title: Amsterdam from the Tolhuis
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a view from the water looking toward a city's harbor. Various ships create a dense silhouette against the sky. The etching technique is evident through cross-hatched lines defining clouds and waves. Several sailboats with figures on board are depicted with detailed rigging and sails. The color palette ranges from light beige to dark sepia, giving the scene a classic appearance.

artworks.title: Weary
artworks.medium: drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body and head of a person, limited to just above the knees. The individual is reclining slightly, with their head turned to the side. Their facial features are rendered in a soft and indistinct manner, with delicate shading suggesting a serene expression. The person's hair is depicted flowing and abundant, stretching out around their head in a wave-like motion. They are clothed in a dark garment, its form suggested with loose and flowing lines. The artwork includes no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background consists of intersecting hatch marks and lines, creating a sense of texture and depth around the figure.

artworks.title: Chelsea Bridge and Church
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank with boats, a distant shoreline, a large boat, a smaller boat, trees, faint architectural structures, and a bridge. The sketch has rough lines and a high horizon with a monochromatic color palette of browns and beiges.

artworks.title: Speke Hall, No.1
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a Tudor-style building surrounded by tall, bare trees. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with the horizon near the top of the composition. The artwork features detailed linework capturing the texture of the trees and architectural details. The color scheme is monochromatic, using sepia tones. A path leads to the building in the background.

artworks.title: The Old Swan Brewery, Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (trimmed to the platemark): 6.67 x 9.84 cm (2 5/8 x 3 7/8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 6.99 x 9.84 cm (2 3/4 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene depicted in a linear, sketched style with buildings in the background and people in the foreground. The lines are fine and delicate, creating a minimalist representation. The color palette is monochromatic, using only the natural tones of the paper and ink.

artworks.title: Draped Model
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person standing. The person has their head slightly tilted to one side, and their gaze is directed forward. Their facial features are softly detailed, with a subtle expression, and they have short, straight hair that frames their face. The individual is wrapped in a flowing garment that envelops most of their body, with lines suggesting the fabric's draping and folds. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background consists of simple, sketchy lines, creating a textured backdrop that emphasizes the figure. The overall composition is minimalist, focusing on the person as the central element in the artwork.

artworks.title: Draped Model
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in an upright position. They are wrapped in a long cloak or garment that covers their body. The person's face is visible, with delicate features and straight hair with a fringe. The background consists of loosely sketched lines, suggesting a wall or flat surface. The scene is depicted in monochromatic tones with fine pencil work.

artworks.title: The Velvet Dress
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman standing in a profile view. She is facing towards the left side of the image with delicate facial features and neatly styled hair. The woman is wearing a long garment with fine detailing around the collar and shoulders. There are no visible accessories or objects in her hands. The background consists of vertical lines that suggest draped fabric or curtains. The sketch emphasizes the woman's form and posture with its minimalistic style.

artworks.title: The Little Velvet Dress
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a side view of a woman standing. She has fair skin, a small mouth, and a slightly pointed nose. Her hair is in a bun, and she wears a long, dark dress with textured details near the neck. The image has a textured background with loose lines, and there are no visible accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Fanny Leyland
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair, facing right, with her body visible in profile view. She has long, wavy hair and is dressed in a detailed gown. She sits with her back straight, hands resting on her lap. The chair is simple in design and the background is plain with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Elinor Leyland
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a person standing with their hands on their hips. The person has a rounded face with a youthful appearance and styled hair. They are wearing a textured outfit, possibly a dress or skirt with a top. The background consists of vertical and diagonal lines. There is a signature or mark on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Tatting
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated, facing the viewer. The person has short, curly hair and is wearing a hat with textured decoration. They wear a dress with a high collar and a shawl. The hands are positioned as if holding something. The background features a vertical line pattern and a faint outline of a small round table to the right of the person.
